physical_code_resources.model: One evolving infinite bath, all forward calls and retained registers counted; no terminal return promise.
physical_code_resources.inner_length: k=floor[1/(256 beta^2)] for 0<beta<=1/32, fixed before outer horizon.
physical_code_resources.rank: rank(I-(ln2/8) beta^2 H_k), at most 3^k; not numerically computed.
physical_code_resources.mean_depth_guarantee: At actual tau_pi only: O_beta(log N) final mean, uniform over logical inputs. No peak intermediate-depth bound.
physical_code_resources.cutoff: H_n=A_n+ceil(((rank rho+16)ln(n+1)+ln(1+C_Lyap))/t). Its coefficient can be enormous.
physical_code_resources.full_diamond_error: min(2, 4 e_n+2 sqrt(1-Tr(P_{<=A_n} tau))), e_n=r_A sqrt(2 epsilon_n)+(1-2 epsilon_n)^(-1/2)-1, epsilon_n=(n+1)^(-16).
physical_code_resources.half_diamond_error: Exactly half the full-error certificate, not the same symbol or constant.
physical_code_resources.universal_quantifier: One code choice; convergence pointwise for each fixed normal initializer, not uniform over all normal states at finite horizon.
physical_code_resources.finite_usefulness: Not established. No efficient preparation, encoder, decoder, spectral optimizer or precision analysis.
